entry.title: T. Rowe Price CEO Sharps on Private Assets and AI Adoption
entry.summary: T. Rowe Price CEO Rob Sharps discusses how the company is adapting to the rise of passive investing. Speaking with Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg The Close," Sharps also says private assets are slowly moving into 401(k) plans and sees "tax-loss harvesting" as a growth area. He also discusses how the firm is utilizing artificial intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: AI Adoption Is Finally Showing Up in Fundamentals
entry.summary: Michelle Weaver, head of US thematic research at Morgan Stanley, says companies are beginning to see measurable benefits from AI as adoption moves from experimentation into production. About 25% of S&P 500 companies are now quantifying benefits from AI, up from 14% a year ago, with AI adopters also seeing relative forward margin expansion. “You’re starting to see this come into the fundamentals.”

entry.title: Nvidia snaps up Hugging Face for $12.9 billion as closed AI labs pull away
entry.summary: Nvidia is buying open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, about 80 times its $150 million annual revenue. The deal fits Nvidia's push to invest billions in open AI models while closed providers like OpenAI and Anthropic move away from Nvidia hardware.
